Name: Barcelona-Sants station
Tips: 07:50 - Metro L5 direct, ~15 min. The ~08:20 fast train (AVE/Avant) is ~38 min; book by ~Aug 26, 2-3 fast trains/hr. The slow R11 is ~1h20 and eats Girona's whole Sunday-morning window.

Name: Pont de les Peixateries Velles
Address: Pont de les Peixateries Velles, 17004 Girona
Tips: 09:25 - start outdoors before anything opens. The red iron footbridge built 1877 by Gustave Eiffel's workshop, TWELVE YEARS BEFORE THE TOWER: same riveted lattice, same red-oxide paint. Mid-span for the classic shot of the painted houses stacked over the water, then cross and shoot back. Empty now, a tripod queue by noon.

Name: Carrer Nou / Rambla de la Llibertat (xuixos)
Tips: 09:45 - coffee and a xuixo (say SHOO-show), Girona's own pastry: a fried sugar-crusted brioche cylinder filled with crema catalana, invented here. Stacked in every pastisseria window along these arcades. Ask for one acabat de fer (just made). One each, they are rich.

Name: El Call (Jewish Quarter)
Tips: 10:15 - DOING IT FIRST TICKS THE DAY'S TIGHTEST DOOR. One of the best-preserved medieval Jewish quarters in Europe: stone lanes barely shoulder-wide, tunnels, staircases going nowhere. Inside it the Bonastruc ça Porta / Museu d'Història dels Jueus with its 12th-century mikvah - SUN 10:00-14:00, last entry ~13:30.

Name: Monestir de Sant Pere de Galligants
Tips: 11:15 - SUN 10:00-14:00. 12th-century Benedictine Romanesque monastery, now the archaeology museum. The cloister is the reason: carved capitals, deep shade, almost nobody in it. Played Braavos on screen.

Name: Jardins de la Francesa
Tips: 11:50 - the free French garden tucked behind the cathedral apse: cypresses, ivy, benches, the cathedral wall towering overhead. THE COOLEST SPOT IN GIRONA, and another Braavos backdrop. Breathe here until noon.

Name: Girona Cathedral
Cost Range: 7.50 EUR adult incl. audio guide (students/pensioners 5, under 16 1.50, under 8 free) - same ticket covers Sant Feliu
Tips: 12:10 - OPENS TO VISITORS ONLY AT 12:00 ON SUNDAYS (12:00-16:30), which is why the morning runs museums-first. The widest Gothic nave in the world (23 m, unsupported). The 90-step baroque staircase out front is the Game of Thrones shot - the Great Sept of Baelor. Inside, do not skip the Tapestry of Creation, an embroidered 11th-century cosmos.

Name: Basílica de Sant Feliu
Tips: 13:10 - OPENS 13:00 SUNDAY (13:00-17:30). Girona's first cathedral, right below: Romanesque columns under a Gothic nave, eight Roman and early-Christian sarcophagi embedded by the altar, tomb of St Narcissus. 20-25 min.

Name: Escales de Sant Martí
Tips: 13:40, 2 min away - the baroque staircase sweeping up to Sant Martí Sacosta. Arya's Braavos chase ran down these steps. Shoot from the bottom looking up.

Name: Bartali Pizza Co.
Tips: 14:00 LUNCH - BOOKED PICK. Neapolitan-style pizza, terrace, 4.8 stars over ~725 reviews, gluten-free bases available. SUNDAY HOURS ARE 13:00-15:30 ONLY - reserve via bartalipizza.com, OpenTable or Resy, or call +34 972 21 09 91. Minutes downhill from the Sant Marti steps.

Name: Plaça de la Independència
Tips: Backup only. The big arcaded square across the river: shaded awnings, easy with four, no booking needed - but it prices for visitors. Girona is Celler de Can Roca's home town; even ordinary kitchens punch above their weight.

Name: Rocambolesc
Tips: 15:30 - Jordi Roca's ice-cream shop, the 5 EUR way to eat three-Michelin-star cooking. Ridiculous toppings, kids love it. Then shaded lanes until the heat breaks.

Name: Passeig de la Muralla
Tips: 16:30 - the medieval ramparts, 1-1.5 km of walkway and climbable towers over terracotta roofs to the Pyrenees foothills. DELIBERATELY AT THE END: fully exposed, no water up there, BRING BOTTLES. Girona is inland and hotter than Barcelona, 32-34 C is normal. Come down near the cathedral.

Name: Girona station (return)
Tips: 18:15 walk to the station (~15 min) for the ~18:40 fast train, Barcelona by ~19:20. CHECK THE LAST FAST DEPARTURES WHEN BOOKING - Sunday evening service thins. If the day feels long, the natural cut is everything after lunch: take a ~16:00 train back.

Name: 7 Portes
Tips: ~21:00 farewell dinner - paella institution SINCE 1836, open daily 13:00-01:00. White jackets, marble tables, paella Parellada and black rice. BOOK NOW for Sunday ~21:00, August weekends fill weeks out. Then pack: tomorrow leaves at 09:40.
